note: Emirates NBD's key facts statement for individuals' current and savings accounts: in the Personal Banking Classic package the minimum balance is 3,000 dirhams, and a fall-below fee of 26.25 dirhams a month (VAT included) is charged when the monthly average is under it. Its exemptions (the Emirati Package, salary-variant customers in other packages) aren't modelled.
